Read input: rtlpp_10534_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_10534(
    input clk, 
    input flash, 
    input [31:0] Hexs, 
    input [7:0] LES, 
    input [7:0] point, 
    input rst, 
    input Start, 
    input SW0, 
    output seg_clk, 
    output seg_clrn, 
    output SEG_PEN, 
    output seg_sout
);

    wire [63:0] XLXN_14;
    wire [63:0] XLXN_15;
    wire [63:0] XLXN_16;

    // Embedded logic for P2S module
    reg [63:0] shift_reg;
    reg [5:0] bit_cnt;

    assign seg_sout = shift_reg[63];
    assign seg_clk = clk;
    assign seg_clrn = ~rst;
    assign SEG_PEN = Start;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            shift_reg <= 64'b0;
            bit_cnt <= 6'b0;
        end else if (Start) begin
            shift_reg <= XLXN_14;
            bit_cnt <= 6'b0;
        end else if (SEG_PEN) begin
            shift_reg <= {shift_reg[62:0], 1'b0};
            bit_cnt <= bit_cnt + 1;
        end
    end

    // Embedded logic for HexTo8SEG8 module
    reg [7:0] segs[7:0];
    integer i;

    always @* begin
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
            segs[i] = (flash) ? 8'b0 : Hexs[i*4 +: 4]; // Simplified conversion logic
        end
    end
    assign XLXN_16 = {segs[7], segs[6], segs[5], segs[4], segs[3], segs[2], segs[1], segs[0]};

    // Embedded logic for MUX2T1_64 module
    assign XLXN_14 = (SW0) ? XLXN_16 : XLXN_15;

    // Embedded logic for SSeg_map module
    assign XLXN_15 = {Hexs, Hexs};

endmodule
